categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Headman Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of high-precision CNC lathes. Its main product categories include high-end CNC lathes, parallel composite machining centers, automated production lines, and popular CNC lathes. These products serve industries such as automotive manufacturing, construction machinery, general equipment, aerospace, and military industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core technologies such as spindle technology, servo turret technology, servo tailstock technology, and thermal compensation technology, all of which are independently developed. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including modular and unitized production systems, intelligent automation, and integration of industrial software for smart manufacturing. The company is also developing five-axis five-linkage composite machining centers and ultra-high precision CNC lathes with static pressure technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in automotive manufacturing (including new energy vehicles), construction machinery, general machinery, aerospace, military industry, and emerging sectors like industrial and humanoid robotics. The automotive sector, especially the new energy vehicle segment, is a major driver of demand. The company also serves domestic and international markets with a growing export presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Yuhuan (Puqing and Shamen) and Shanghai Lingang. It serves domestic markets extensively and has an expanding overseas market presence through agents and distributors. Major domestic sales are concentrated in Zhejiang province and other provinces such as Jiangsu, Anhui, Guangdong, and Chongqing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Headman operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of CNC machine tools and intelligent equipment. It produces core components such as spindles, turrets, and tailstocks, some of which are self-developed, while sourcing other key components like CNC systems and linear guides from specialized suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-precision and high-end CNC lathe development, focusing on breakthroughs in five-axis machining, ultra-high precision static pressure technology, and intelligent manufacturing software. It emphasizes independent innovation, collaboration with universities, and integration of industrial software to enhance smart manufacturing capabilities. R&D investments are significant, with ongoing projects in new product development and core technology upgrades.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of CNC machine tools and related automated production lines. The company employs a mixed sales model including direct sales, agency sales, and distributor sales domestically and internationally. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income related to its equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhejiang Headman is positioned as a leading domestic high-end CNC lathe manufacturer and is the only listed company in China specializing exclusively in CNC lathes. It competes with international giants from Germany, Japan, and the US, as well as strong domestic players. The company holds a competitive edge in precision and core component autonomy, with recognized industry awards and national-level certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 765 million, a 15.31% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 25.8 million, a 12.27% decrease. Total assets reached RMB 1.67 billion, up 14.83%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and production capacity expansion, with ongoing investments in production base expansions and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, reliability, and intelligent automation in its CNC machine tools, offering differentiated products with advanced core technologies such as independently developed spindles and servo turrets. Its products support complex, high-precision machining needs in key industries, providing integrated solutions including automation and software to enhance manufacturing efficiency and flexibility. The focus on customer-specific engineering and full lifecycle service further strengthens its competitive advantage.
